blocks.text: COTABATO CITY—Presidential Peace Adviser Mel Senen Sarmiento had asked Congress to boost government’s funding for peacebuilding initiatives to help transition once war-torn communities into peaceful and productive zones, using funds cut from flood control projects of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH). This developed as the Senate on Friday approved its P9.4-billion budget
